description:
Aspect2 Shimano

The latest evolution of our unique MASON Aspect, optimised for conventional internal routing.

The titanium MASON Aspect is our ultimate FastFar bicycle for multi-surface road riding. It’s a truly compelling bike that has become loved by those who want to travel smooth and fast over variable road surfaces – on a bike made to last a lifetime.

Originally conceived to be the titanium cousin of our steel Resolution, the handmade Aspect has continued to evolve into something unique. This brand new version blends a raft of improvements with the tried-and-tested internal routing loved by many riders. Our new Aspect Integrale offers the new option of fully integrated routing.

NEW – Aspect2

Internal routing for cables and hoses

NEW MASON designed, UDH-ready 3D-printed dropouts

Choice of mechanical or electronic shifting

All-road geometry tuned for endurance and multi-surface comfort at speed

MASON Aperture2 carbon fork

The titanium multi-surface road bike, tuned for comfort, distance and all-season practicality

We developed an entirely new titanium tubeset for the Aspect in collaboration with Dedacciai in Italy, achieving the ultimate blend of performance, comfort, and light weight. With Italian craftsmanship and exceptional finish quality, the small-batch Aspect is truly a special creation.

The fork plays a crucial role in the performance of the frameset and finished machine, so an updated MASON Aperture2 carbon fibre fork matches the Aspect2 perfectly.

Each Aspect is welded to order. Your bike is tailored with the custom details and individualised options that will make it truly yours:

Multiple routing options to suit mechanical, electronic or fully wireless groupsets

Choice of bottle and accessory eyelets Dedicated dynamo cable routing option

Shorter headtube option (on all sizes except 48cm)

Our Shimano-equipped Aspect2 options include a choice of Dura-Ace Di2, Ultegra Di2 or 105 Di2 groupsets, as well as mechanical Ultegra or 105.

Mason X Dedacciai custom formed and shaped titanium 3AL-2.5V frame

NEW Finessed downtube profile, with increased frame-size-dependent diameter, tailoring the Aspect for the weight and power of its rider: 42mm diameter on 48-52cm sizes, 48mm diameter for 54-62cm

Available with a choice of the best 700C tyres from René Herse, Schwalbe, Continental and Vittoria

Available with 'MASON Luminance Upgrade': the ultimate dynamo lighting set-up for all-terrain and multi-surface adventures

Fully compatible with full-length mudguards. Choose from SKS 35mm or PDW FullMetalFender 37mm.

NEW Optional dedicated dynamo routing, enabling the Aspect to be built into a true four-season bike for that extends your riding year into – and right through – the darker months

Available with Dura-Ace Di2, Ultegra Di2, 105 Di2, Ultegra mechanical, 105 mechanical

Choice of mechanical or electronic shifting

Shorter headtube option (on all sizes except 48cm)

NEW Completely redesigned chainstays and seatstays: chainstays with a revised bend, deeper section and slimmer profile; lighter, more slender seatstays, with a new triple bend and upper profile.

All-road geometry tuned for endurance and multi-surface comfort at speed

MASON Penta carbon microadjust seatpost and MASON Macro seatclamp included (MASON Sensor titanium post available as upgrade)
